def inpaint(arr, box):
    """fill box columns by reflecting the wider side strip (left or right), tiling by repeated reflection"""
    x0,y0,x1,y1 = box; a = arr.copy(); H,Wd,_ = a.shape
    left, right = x0, Wd - x1
    w = x1 - x0
    if left >= right:
        src = arr[:, :x0][:, ::-1]          # reflected left strip: first column is the one adjacent to the box
    else:
        src = arr[:, x1:]                    # right strip, will be reflected so that adjacency holds at right edge
        src = src[:, ::-1]                   # now last column is adjacent to the box's right edge... build fill reversed
    L = src.shape[1]
    # tile by reflection to width w
    cols = []
    k = 0
    while sum(c.shape[1] for c in cols) < w:
        cols.append(src if k % 2 == 0 else src[:, ::-1]); k += 1
    fill = np.concatenate(cols, axis=1)[:, :w]
    if left >= right:
        a[y0:y1, x0:x1] = fill[y0:y1]
    else:
        # for right source: we want column x1-1 to match arr[:, x1] etc. src(before reversal) = arr[:, x1:]; reflect about x1
        src2 = arr[:, x1:]
        cols = []; k = 0
        while sum(c.shape[1] for c in cols) < w:
            cols.append(src2 if k % 2 == 0 else src2[:, ::-1]); k += 1
        fill2 = np.concatenate(cols, axis=1)[:, :w][:, ::-1]
        a[y0:y1, x0:x1] = fill2[y0:y1]
    return a
